name: BIGbench (Biases of Image Generation)
description: Text-to-Image (T2I) generative models are becoming increasingly crucial due to their ability to generate high-quality images, but also raise concerns about social biases, particularly in human image generation. Sociological research has established systematic classifications of bias. Yet, existing studies on bias in T2I models largely conflate different types of bias, impeding methodological progress. In this paper, we introduce BIGbench, a unified benchmark for Biases of Image Generation, featuring a carefully designed dataset. Unlike existing benchmarks, BIGbench classifies and evaluates biases across four dimensions to enable a more granular evaluation and deeper analysis. Furthermore, BIGbench applies advanced multi-modal large language models to achieve fully automated and highly accurate evaluations. We apply BIGbench to evaluate eight representative T2I models and three debiasing methods. Our human evaluation results by trained evaluators from different races underscore BIGbench's effectiveness in aligning images and identifying various biases. Moreover, our study also reveals new research directions about biases with insightful analysis of our results. Our work is openly accessible at https://github.com/BIGbench2024/BIGbench2024/.
evaluation_method: Human evaluation and automated multimodal LLM-based evaluation; primary scoring reported as bias classification accuracy / bias rate across predefined bias dimensions
general_score_metric: Bias classification accuracy / bias rate (multi-dimensional summary of different bias types)
reputation: A recent (2024) focused benchmark for bias in text-to-image models that has attracted interest from researchers studying fairness and multimodal bias, but not yet a community standard.
notes: Contains sensitive human-centered content; automated LLM evaluations can reflect annotator/model cultural biases. Human rater variability and cultural context are important caveats; not an LLM-generation benchmark per se but a multimodal bias evaluation dataset.
